text: Regulators' relative unsophistication about the technology is itself a risk driver, because a poorly informed regulator is likely to over-react and precipitate new or expanded regulation.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Blockchain-Based Securities Offerings (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411110
abstract: The relative unsophistication of the regulators and the lack of regulators' understanding of the technology could result in an over-reaction which in turn can precipitate creating new / expanding existing regulations.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: regulators lacking technical understanding of blockchain
